---
title: "Zainab Wain Karey Aa Ja Abbas Bhira Lyrics Punjabi 2020"
language: "Panjabi"
lang: "pa"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Other"
poet: "Hasan"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Zainab Wain Karey Aa Ja Abbas Bhira.
Hath Rasiyaan Te Sir Nangay Aj Jana Sham De Rah.
Main Malik-e-Haya Waan Mera Naa Le Bulanday Ne.
Kita Na Ais Ummat Ne Teri Sain Da Haya.

2
Quran Diyaan Aayataan Munh Walaan Wich Luka Ke.
Kinj Turna Naal Sharabiyaan De Mainu Aa Ke Veer Sikha.
Tatheer Diyaan Paliyaan Wich Mulk Begana Aye.
Saday Sarey Shimar Ne Khaimay Haye Lut Layi Pak Rida.

3
Chadraan Da Maan Taun Ayein Darya Te So Gaya Ayein.
Haye Zalim Has Has Kenday Ne Abbas Nu Bola.
Har Matami Di Maula Howay Dua Qabool Aye.
Aina Nu Naal Hasan De Fair Karbala Bola.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/zainab-wain-karey-aa-ja-abbas-bhira-lyrics-punjabi-2020-tajpoints-3f8e78b4e9c62cb3002d.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True)
_, meta, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = '\\n'.join(line.removeprefix('  ') for line in meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1].splitlines())
original = old.split('---', 2)[2].strip()
assert roman.strip().casefold() == original.replace('.\\n', '\\n').removesuffix('.').casefold()
for edition, numbers in [(roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')]:
    blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert [block[0] for block in blocks] == list(numbers)
    assert [len(block) - 1 for block in blocks] == [4, 4, 4]
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Roman wording preserved and both editions have three matching four-verse stanzas.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, with capitalization and verse endings normalized. Both editions have three matching four-verse stanzas.

Updated the titles and script metadata, and removed `noUrdu`. I read the ambiguous Roman “Sarey” as `ساڑے` (burned) in the line about Shimar and the tents. Only the selected lyric was edited.
